tei:titleStmt.tei:title: tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi
tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi

tei:div.tei:p: tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgya yi ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas/ mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dpal rdo rje ngag gi dbang phyug dpa' bo grub pa/ rgyal po chen po rol pa la sogs te 'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs dang*/ de'i rig pa'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed po/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gdong drug pa/ gdong brgya pa/ bye ba'i phyogs

( phyag ) can la sogs pa dang*/ rig pa'i yum skra can ma/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dang*/ tra ma can zer ba'ang snang*/ legs pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ dpal chen mo la sogs te/ 'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka'= po tā la'i pho brang nas thugs rje chen po'i bdag po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa/ don yod lcags kyu/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seṅge sgra/ kha sarpa ṇi/ ha la ha la/ yid bzhin nor bu/ phyag stong spyan stong la sogs te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs/ de'i rig pa'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ rta mgrin/ rta mgrin dkar po/ mtha' yas mgrin | mgrin sngon/ rgyu skar rgyal po la sogs pa dang*/ sgrol ma/ sgrol dkar dang | gos dkar can/ rnam gzigs ma/ ral gcig ma/ dkar sham ma/ grags ldan ma dang*/ khro gnyer can la sogs te/ padma'i rgyal mo'i rigs kyi rig pa'i rgyal mo grangs med tshad med pas bskor ba'i bka'= lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas mthu stobs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la/ rab tu grub pa dang | rdo rje ral pa la sogs te rig pa'i rgyal po bdun/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor la sogs te khro bo chen po dam pa brgyad/ stobs po che dang*/ rdo rje rnam 'joms la sogs pa snying po mchog brgyad/ lag bzang dang*/ lag myur/ rdo rje'i sde/ rtse mo can/ rdo rje'i gos/ rig pa'i tshogs dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la sogs te rig pa'i rgyal po'i tshogs dang*/ rdo rje blo gros ma la sogs te pho nya chen mo bcu/ rdo rje lte ba dang*/ brgyad hreXbs la sogs te phyag brnyan drug cu rtsa bzhi/ rdo rje lu gu brgyud/ gtun shing la sogs te rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya'i tshogs tshad med grangs med pas bskor ba'i gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i bka'= khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba/ 'jig rten gsum snang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba

| mi g.yo mgon po/ bgegs kyi bdag po/ sprin gyi sgron me/ rdo rje mchu la sogs te rig sngags kyi khro bo thams cad kyi bka'= 'phags ma rig pa'i rgyal mo so so 'brang ma dang*/ rma bya chen mo la sogs pa lnga/ gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can/ rnam par rgyal ma/ phyir bzlog pa chen mo gzhan gyis mi thub pa ri khrod ma lo ma can/ gza' yum/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ma la sogs te gzungs sngags kyi lha mo thams cad kyi bka'= chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ yul nyer bzhi'am sum cu rtsa gnyis na bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro/ de'i bka' 'khor na bzhugs pa'i gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ las dang zhing las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi bka'= chos skyong kun gyi gtso bo dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ las kyi gshin rje | mkha' 'gro ma 'bar ba'i gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka'= sgos kyi chos skyong la sogs mahā kā la zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa | ma mo kun gyi gtso mo/ dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka'= gzhan yang mahā de wa la sogs lha chen po brgyad/ nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' chen po brgyad/ dbang bdag la sogs te phyogs skyong bcu/ mahā bhai ra wa la sogs te 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ yul 'khor skyong ba la sogs te rgyal po chen po bzhi/ smin drug la sogs te rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka'= gang ba bzang po dang nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod spyin chen po brgyad/ 'brog gnas mched lnga/ gang po dang ser skya la sogs te sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yang dag shes dang rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs te mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lngas rtsen la 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgyas bskor ba'i bka'=

tshogs bdag gi tshogs/ khro bo'i tshogs/ bran gyi tshogs/ pho nya'i tshogs/ 'jig rten pa'i yul lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bka'= gzhan yang sman gyi lha/ bstan chos kyi lha/ char sprin gyi lha/ lo tog gi lha/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i lha la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi bka'= gtsug lag khang gi bdag po/ gnas chen po brgyad dang bcu drug mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul/ ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang gi chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi bka'= gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i ma bdun la sogs pa ma mo'i tshogs dang*/ srin mo chen mo bdun cu la sogs te srin mo'i tshogs/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs/ phra men ma'i tshogs/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs/ sring mo bzhi ming po dang bcas pa/ shing gseb kyi lha drug cu rtsa bzhi/ drang srong gi mchog mchod rten bdun la sogs te drang srong gi tshogs dang | skye dgu'i bdag po'i tshogs/ rig sngags 'chang gi tshogs/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzang ris/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig 'khyil ba can | srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa/ grul bum gyi rgyal po kun tu lhan cig sa bdag 'phags chen po la sogs pa dang*/ bod khams skyong ba'i dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa/ lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi bka'= gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig bsam yas kyi rdo rje rab brtan ma/ spu rangs kyi rdo rje bde ldan ma/ khyung lung gi spyan gcig ma | sra dam las kyi dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa phyugs bdag mo thams cad kyi bka'= 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che yab lha gdal drug 'o de gung rgyal/ thang lha yar zhud/ thang 'bring 'u dkar/ thang sras 'chor po/ sku lha ge god sum brgya drug cu/ yar lha sham po/ rma chen spom ra/ gtsang lha yu dar/ bu le dkar po/ sgyogs chen gdong ra/

gnam lha dkar po/ byang rta sgo'i lha btsan la sogs pa lha dgu/ gung dgu/ be dbu rtse dgu/ lha rje dgu/ 'bangs kyi pho lha/ mkhar gyi rtse lha/ yul gyi yul lha la sogs pa lha gnyan pa thams cad la phud 'thor nas dza gad phud kyi mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ bya'o/ /bden pa bdar nas/ 'di skad du bya'o// kī la ya'i phur dbal mi ston/ ma mo'i thun mi rdeg yungs dkar gyi rbab mi gtong*/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo mi bskor/ dbang chen gyi rta bro mi rdung*/ sbyin sreg gi las mi bya/ drag po'i sngags mi bzla/ 'jigs pa'i pho nya mi 'gyed/ kha ngan du mi zer | lagaX pas tshig tu mi drodaX/ mi chen po'i ming nas mi 'bod/ g.yag chen po'i rwa nas mi 'dzin/ bden pa'i dam bdar/zhi ba'i chos bshad/ mthun pa'i zas ster bas/ khyed rnams bzang po'i sna ma 'dren/ ngan pa'i rgyab ma byed par zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs shigamanyam pa'i sa la 'khod cig dgos na stong grogs mdzod cigagrogs mi mdzad na'ang gnod 'gal ma mdzad cig gzhan yang bdud kyi rgyal po ri nag spungs pa/ ri rtse gong g.yag da bdud thod phreng can/ kong rje brang dkar/ te le khyab/ sa 'dar 'khrigs pa/ mi nag gtum pa/ nag po bem pa | kha g.yal lce che/ nag po bkrag med/ gza' bdud nag po la sogs te/ bdud kyi rgyal po bcu/ blon po bskos 'debs bdun/ gyed pa sde bzhi/ kung pa sde bzhi/ pho nya bla rkun/ rgya sa rmagaX bcu gsum/ 'ching ba'i zhags thogs/ gcod pa'i st+war thogs/ brnga ba'i zor thogs/ 'dzedaX pa 'gyogs thogs/ gshan pa gri thogs/ bdud rigs stong phrag brgyad cu thams cad la kī la ya'i phur dbal mi ston/ zhes pa nas/ gnod 'gal ma mdzad kyi bar kun la 'gre'o// bdud mi la ma lab ( bab ) khram shing la ma 'debs/ pho bdud g.yas su sgyur/ mo bdud g.yon du sgyur/ spyi bdud mkha' la sgyur/ gzhan yang dmu'i rgyal po/ dmu rgyal ge thung*/ dmu rje legs pa/ dmu lcam phra mo la sogs pa dmu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad la/

kī la ya'i= dmu gab ma 'gebs/ dmu rdo ma rdeg dmu lce dang*/ dmu zhwa dang*/ dmu 'brum dang*/ dmu lkugs dang*/ dmu chu ma gtong*/ gzhan yang btsan rje mthu bo lag ring*/ yam shud dmar po/ che btsan gyi rgyal po yang ne ber/ btsun mo la mgo g.yu mtsho/ blon po ke ta bzhi cu rtsa gnyis/ lkugs pa sde bzhi/ rtsal thogs rgyud kyi gri btsan dmar po/ phyi'i sgo ba/ nang gi sgo ba/ sman 'brog rol mo bdun cu/ gri btsan sum rgya drug cu/ brag gdong dmar po/ bse gdong khra bo/ dmag dpon 'khor dang bcas pa/ yab ya ba skya gcig rol pa skya bdun/ skyo ba klu btsan/ lha btsan rol pa'i rgyal po/ bhang btsan | gzhan btsan smug po/ gdong btsan/ se btsan/ brag btsan/ bdud btsan | gri btsan/ klu btsan/ yul btsan/ shar dri za'i btsan/ lho gshin rje'i btsan | nub klu'i btsan/ byang gnod sbyin gyi btsan/ btsan phran nyi khri chig stong po thams cad la/ kī la ya'i= gri 'thab dang gzer nad ma gtong zhig gzhan yang 'od lha dkar po/ ya chos dkar po/ 'us rang dkar po/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ gnam lha byang chub/ li byin ha ra/ nyi spang sad/ zla spang sad/ skya rengs gser phreng can/ g.yu phreng can/ dung phreng can/ mchong phreng can/ gzi phreng can te phreng lnga/ shel gyi srog bdag dmar po/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje gzhon nu/ rdo rje lde dkar/ rdo rje bye brag skyes/ btsan 'gong dmar po/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i rgyal po/ sa gzhi la gnas pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ kī la ya'i= smyo 'bogs dang*/ brgyal nad ma gtong*/ gzhan yang mi rigs kyi dbang du byas na/ sa gzhi la bskyed pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi/ dkar smug gnag gsum/ gru 'degs ma bzhi/ dkar ser dmar ljang sogs sde bzhi/ bya zhon ma/ bong zhon ma/ dre'u zhon ma/ mdzo zhon ma/ nag mo khal dkar gyi steng*/ lho dkar 'dab khra'i bdag mo/ rgyu gzer khrag nad kyi bdag mo | bal nad glang thabs kyi bdag mo/

rgya nad mig ser gyi bdag mo/ 'brum bu g.yas ma'i bdag mo/ bdud mo me'i phod kha can/ chu'i phod kha can/ rlung gi phod kha can/ nad kyi phod kha can/ ri rab kyi ma mo/ gling gi srin mo/ dur khrod kyi sha za mo/ bting gi bdud mo/ chu'i klu mo/ mkha'i dpral mo/ byang gi 'brog mo | dmu sman dang byang sman/ sman btsun dang klu bdud mo la sogs pa mo rigs kyi gdon thams cad la/ kī la ya'i= dal kha dang rims nad ma gtong zhig gzhan yang klu rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs dang*/ dmangs rigs/ sa 'dzin pa tshe ring*/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ dbang che ba/ ratna'i gzhal med khang chen po la gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ klu phal pa rigs bzhi dang*/ bā su ta rigs drug dang*/ klu chu la gnas pa/ gnyan shing la gnas pa/ sa bdag sa la gnas pa/ zhing sa'am/ khang sa'am/ dur sa'am/ mtshe'u ltang lteng ma/ chu mig 'jag 'jig gam/ sing ma gya gyu'am/ tshigs gya gyu'am/ lu ma brang breng la gnas pa sogs khyed rnams la/ kī la= mdze shu dang g.yan pa ma gtong*/ 'byung po grong rgyu ba dam nyams pa kun gyi rgyab ma byed/ byas na spal pa rma can gcig gis sbal pa'i dong rul/ rta rid rngo can gyis yo ma'i khyu 'phung ba bzhin du/ khyed rang yang 'phung 'gro/ de bas na bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' khyad du ma gsod/ sbyin pa chud ma gson/ lha 'dre dam btsan | spyang ki sngon po yang gtsong la mi 'goms pa yin pas/ zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs shig 'byung po grong rgyu ltogs 'dod can/ khyi gzugs phyir 'breng ba/ mi 'grul phyir 'ong ba/ srod kyi 'jab rku/ tho rengs kyi rkun bu/ gshin gyi dra dri khyod nyon cig tshe la snga phyi yod/ las la rgyu 'bras yod/ skye gnas la bde sdug yod pas/ khyod tshe snga ma la las ngan pa spyad pas/ da lta yi dwags gnod sems can 'di 'drar skyes pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/

skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can/ zhes gsungs pas/ khyed kyang 'chi ba'i dus 'ong ngo*/ /shi nas med par mi 'gro'o/ /sems can las kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ mdo las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za//tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ yang yang skye dgos so/ de yang las dge bas bde 'gror skye la/ sdig pas ngan 'gror skye ste/ sa bon tsha ba rnams la ni/ /'bras bu tsha ba skye bar 'gyur/ /sa bon mngar ba rnams la ni/ /'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur | | zhes dang*/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis/ dge ba yis ni bde ba 'byung | | sdig pa yis ni sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /zhes dang*/ yum las/ gcig tu nag po'i las kyi rnam par smin pas/ sems can dmyal ba dang byol song dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas kyang*/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab na sdig pa yi/ /las kyi 'bras bu gang lags mngon par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khyed kyang las ngan pa'i lus zhig 'og tu sems can dmyal ba yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med par skyes nas/ der me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myag gi 'dam/ spu gri brdal ba'i thang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags/ shal ma ri yi sdong po/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med la sogs pa sdug bsngal bzod pa'i thabs med pa/ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes kyang mi skyob na | las ma zad bar thon pa'i dus mi 'ong ste/ yum las 'jig rten gyi khams 'di mes yongs su 'jig pa'am/ chus yongs su 'jig pa'i tshe yang*/ sems can dmyal ba pa de dag shar phyogs kyi sems can dmyal ba chen por 'dor bar 'gyur/ de dag tu yang me dang chu dang rlung gis 'jig pa'i tshe/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang dang*/ byang shar dang*/ shar lho dang*/ lho nub dang*/ nub byang dang | steng dang*/

'og dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thon pa'i dus med do/ /de bas na las ngan pa'i 'phro chod/ lam nor ba las log pa yin/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang*/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du ma gsod/ sa gzhi 'di nam mkha' la 'phags kyang srid/ nyi zla ni sa la ltung yang srid/ chu klung chen po ni gyen la ldog kyang srid/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ni gzhan du 'gyur mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan la gnod pa rdzun gyi tshig /smra ba'i tshig de rgyu med phyir/ / nyes zad ngag tu shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' la nyon cig rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig | mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem | | zhes gsungs pas/ khyed rang la yang gnod pa chen po byas na dga'am khe chung zhing nyen che ba la ma gol bar song zhig nam mkha' stong pa la gshog ru 'dzing ba'i don med/ thang kha yangs po la rta rkyang thug pa'i don med do/ /des na khyod rang gi sa dang rang gnas su song zhig dengs shig byer cig gal te bden pa bdar kyang mi nyan te/ zhi bas 'akrol yang mi nyan/ bkur stis mchod kyang mi 'gro na/ /bden pa chen po'i chad pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' chad kyis/ khyed brlag pas na mtha' med pa dang*/ mgo bo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du/ tshal pa bdun du 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu gdug pa drag po la/ /zhi bas nye bar mi sbyor bar/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ khro bor de bzhin sku sprul mdzad/ /ces gsungs pas/ gong du smos pa'i gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo dang*/ phyag brnyan dang*/ pho nya'i tshogs thams cad kyis/ khyed rnams thal bar brlag par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nga yi dpung*/ /tshangs pa brgya byin nga yi dpung*/ /'byung ba bzhi po nga yi dpung*/ /thams cad nga yi dpung gyur nas/

khyed rnams brlag par 'gyur nges so/ /de bas na song zhig byer cig dengs shig tshangs pa'i gzi brjid kyis thal bar brlag par 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin gyi rdo rjes khyed kyi lus ngag 'bigs par 'gyur ro/ khyab 'jug gi 'khor los shog par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na song zhig byeracig dengs shig sarba bighna gatstsha/

zhes brjod cing drag sngags bzlas so/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bden bdar chen mo rdzogs so/ /spyir gtor ma dang bden bdar lan gsum byas nas gdungs na mi thul mi srid do/ /sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// 'di'i ma phyi gcig las ma rnyed la yig nor rnams bcos yod/ the tshom can la rtagasaX| 'di 'dra re yod pas blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod mdzod// // dkar po rnam gsum dang 'phags pa'i gsung rab kha skong pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i zhul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 200PAGE 199
